newsitem.title: USA: Superior Surgical sees rising sales/earnings.
newsitem.headline: Superior Surgical sees rising sales/earnings.

text.p: Superior Surgical Mfg. Co Inc said Thursday it was confident its rising sales and earnings trend will continue for the rest of the year.
Gerald Benstock, chairman and chief executive officer, issued the forecast as the company reported what Benstock said was "the best sales quarter" in its 77-year history.
"Our incoming order rate remains strong and the execution of multi-year contracts continues to accelerate," he added.

Superior Surgical, which manufactures uniforms, career apparel and accessories, said that, for the second quarter ended June 30, sales increased eight percent to to a record $37.5 million compared with $34.9 million in the quarter a year ago. It said net income rose 10 percent to $2.3 million, or $0.29 per, common share, compared with $2.1 million or $0.26 per common share in the 1996 quarter.
